$comment: Repos the content engine watches. Add entries freely; set enabled=false to mute one without losing its notes.

sources.label: MCP spec + docs
sources.why_it_matters: The protocol spec itself. Dated revision releases (e.g. 2026-07-28) are the clearest signal of where agent tooling is headed, and spec changes break or unlock real integrations.

sources.label: MCP reference servers
sources.why_it_matters: Reference server implementations. New servers are concrete 'you can now connect X' stories and map directly to tutorial content.

sources.label: Hugging Face Transformers
sources.why_it_matters: New model architectures land here before most coverage exists. Release notes name the models, which is strong search demand early.

sources.label: Hugging Face Diffusers
sources.why_it_matters: Image and video generation pipelines. Highest visual-payoff source in the set, so it carries shorts and thumbnails well.

sources.label: Higgsfield (distributed training framework)
sources.why_it_matters: Open-source distributed training/orchestration framework. Low activity - last release v0.0.4-rc in March 2024 - so treat it as background/evergreen material, not a news source. Note this is NOT the Higgsfield video-generation product, which has no public repo.
